يشق (form I)
# يَشُقُّ (yašuqqu) /ja.ʃuq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of شَقَّ (šaqqa)
# يُشَقُّ (yušaqqu) /ju.ʃaq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of شَقَّ (šaqqa)
# يَشُقَّ (yašuqqa) /ja.ʃuq.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَقَّ (šaqqa)
# يُشَقَّ (yušaqqa) /ju.ʃaq.qa/: third-person masc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
